h1: Find Your Perfect Office for Rent in Dubai
supporting: Premium Furnished Offices, Flexible Workspaces and Ejari Solutions Across Dubai.
intro_heading: Offices for rent across Dubai, from Deira to JLT
intro: Looking for an office for rent in Dubai? Property Rent Hub helps entrepreneurs, startups and established companies discover professional workspaces that match their business requirements, preferred location and budget.
Explore furnished private offices, serviced offices, shared workspaces and virtual office solutions across Al Barsha, Port Saeed, Sheikh Zayed Road, Jumeirah Lakes Towers and Business Bay.
Whether you are establishing a new company, expanding your operations or relocating your existing business, we help you explore suitable office rental options and arrange property viewings.
intro_close: Find your next workspace with Property Rent Hub.
line_note: All five areas sit on the Dubai Metro Red Line, so your team can reach any of them by train.
directory_intro: Our current office options by area. Availability changes quickly, so message us for today's list and full rental details.

types.name: Furnished private office
types.text: A lockable office for your team with the furniture already in place, so you can move in and start working. Ask whether internet, utilities and meeting-room access are included in the rent.
types.message: Hello Property Rent Hub, I'm interested in a furnished private office in Dubai. Please share the available options and rental details.

types.name: Serviced office
types.text: A private office inside a managed business centre, with shared services such as reception and meeting rooms. Services are usually bundled with the rent; confirm exactly what is covered.
types.message: Hello Property Rent Hub, I'm interested in a serviced office in Dubai. Please share the available options and what is included.

types.name: Shared workspace
types.text: A desk in a shared office. It keeps costs down for freelancers and one- or two-person companies. Check that the arrangement is accepted for your licence before you sign.
types.message: Hello Property Rent Hub, I'm interested in a shared workspace or desk in Dubai. Please share the options and rental details.

types.name: Virtual office
types.text: A business address without a desk of your own. Some licence types accept this and others do not, so confirm with your licensing authority first and ask us what each package includes.
types.message: Hello Property Rent Hub, I'm interested in a virtual office solution in Dubai. Please share the options and what is included.

steps_heading: How to book an office viewing

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.text: Send your preferred area, team size, budget and move-in date on WhatsApp. If you need Ejari for a trade licence, mention it at the start.

steps.title: Get matching options
steps.text: We send offices that fit, with the rent, what each one includes and its Ejari details, plus photos of the actual office.

steps.title: View and decide
steps.text: Pick a time to see the office in person and bring your questions about the contract, payments and move-in date.

guides_heading: Guides to renting an office in Dubai
final_text: Tell us the area, your team size and when you want to move in, and we will arrange a viewing at a time that suits you.
